text: Everyone gets distracted at times. Create rules for positive procrastination. Rather than wasting time on social media, read a book, call a friend or do something positive you enjoy doing.

name: Pareto Principle
lead: For many outcomes, roughly 80% of consequences come from 20% of the causes
text: Before starting any task, determine the vital 20% that can give you 80% of the result. Often 80% is all you need.

name: Schedule
lead: Scheduling is the art of planning your activities so you can achieve your goals
text: Schedule your most important tasks first. Fit everything else around that. —— On schedule https://seths.blog/2022/01/on-schedule/ Mason Jar fills up https://tim.blog/2018/08/29/the-tim-ferriss-show-transcripts-drew-houston/

name: M&M Test
lead: Little things matter
text: The rock band Van Halen had a “brown M&M's clause” in their contracts with event organisers. The organisers were to provide M&M's in the backstage area, but that there must be no brown M&M's in the bowl. This small clause gave the band an easy way to check whether organisers actually paid attention to all the details in the contract.

name: Relax
lead: Sometimes you just need to unwind and relax
text: Next time you're feeling stressed, just kick back and relax for a bit.

name: Eat Real Food
lead: Eat real food. Not too much. Mostly plants
text: If your grandmother doesn't recognise it, it's probably unhealthy. Avoid things with more than five ingredients. Or anything that never goes bad. Real food eventually rots, and that's OK.

name: Donkey Rule
lead: Don't be a donkey
text: The donkey can't decide between hay and water, eventually dying of hunger and thirst. A donkey can't think of the future. If he could, he'd realise that he could first drink the water and then go eat the hay.

name: The One Thing
lead: Do the one thing that will have the biggest effect
text: Ask yourself at all times: "What's the one thing I can do that will make everything else easier or unnecessary?" When playing golf, focus on the hole you're playing. Everything else is unnecessary.

name: Keep Calm
lead: Choose calm over crazy
text: Keeping calm in stressful situations is always the best option. Remember: It's not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters.

name: Kiss Many Frogs
lead: You have to kiss many frogs to find a prince
text: Segway Inc. used to hold Frog Kissing Days. They would take time to try out crazy new ideas and explicitly celebrate spectacular failures. Sometimes, one of those crazy ideas ended up being a prince. Go out and experiment. Either you'll win or you'll grow.

name: Make Your Move
lead: Emotions follow motion
text: When you're feeling down, make a high-energy move to snap right out of it. Do jumping jacks, push-ups, or a power pose (stand like Superman). If you want to change your state of mind, move your body. Watch (1 min) Tony Robbins: Make Your Move

name: Tree Rule
lead: If you don't like where you're standing, move
text: You're not a tree. If you find yourself in a situation that is not serving you, remove yourself from it. If you find yourself in a situation that isn't meeting your needs, change it. Ask yourself, what would make life more wonderful for you? Then take the appropriate action.

name: Tidy Up
lead: If you want to clear your head, clean your space first
text: Visible mess helps distract us from the true source of disorder. Visible mess distracts us from the true source of disorder. Get to the true source in six simple steps: Commit yourself to tidying up. Imagine your ideal lifestyle. Start by discarding. Tidy by category, not location. Follow the right order and ask yourself it it sparks joy? Read (6 min) Marie Kondo: Six Rules Of Tidying Up

name: Be a Vault
lead: Build a reputation of being a vault
text: Never kiss and tell. Trust and reputation are among the most valuable currencies in life. They take years to build but only seconds to destroy.

name: Level Up
lead: You are your standards From others and especially from yourself
text: If you want to improve your life, raise your standards.

name: Greener Grass
lead: The grass is always greener on the other side
text: Make it a habit to remember that everyone constantly seeks what they don't have. You're living someone else's biggest dream. The next time you're enviously looking at someone else's grass, find something to be grateful for. We often take the things we have for granted, constantly chasing the next thing. But that will only satisfy us temporarily. Gratitude is more sustainable. —————— https://www.healthygamer.gg/blog/the-scientific-benefits-of-touching-grass

name: Be a Lighthouse
lead: Be the change you wish to see
text: A lighthouse can't force ships to change course. It helps them navigate. Shine your light brightly and clearly. Be a lighthouse

name: Daily Highlight
lead: Have a daily highlight
text: Start your day by deciding on a highlight and schedule time for it. This way, you'll have something fun to look forward to every day.

name: Sleep
lead: Sleep seven hours every night
text: Everything you do, you'll do better with a good night's sleep. A good night's sleep lowers your overall stress level, improves your mood, and enhances your health.

name: Take the Stairs
lead: Whenever you have the option, take the stairs
text: Always take the stairs. This simple strategy improves self-discipline as well as your overall health and fitness. Literally, take the stairs.

name: Be Legendary
lead: Be legendary on any scale
text: Champions come and go, but to be legendary you have to have heart, more heart than the next person, more heart than anyone in the world - Muhammad Ali. Whatever you do, do it with all your heart.

name: Five People Rule
lead: You're the average of the five people you spend the most time with
text: Choose your five people wisely. Spend time with people who motivate, excite, and push you. Also, beware of the effects of your negative, unambitious, or angry friends.

name: Celebrate
lead: Celebrate successes, even small ones
text: Celebrate your wins, often the journey is the destination. Enjoy the journey. Acknowledge what you have accomplished. This will give you the energy and motivation to achieve even more.

name: Laugh
lead: Laugh as much as you can, every day
text: The average child laughs 300 times in a day. The average adult laughs only 30 times a day. Laughing releases endorphins, giving a feeling like a runner's high. It lowers cortisol, making us feel calmer. And it release dopamine, the same hormone released during sex, making us feel more bonded In essence. For our brains laughing is thus like exercising, meditating and having sex at the same time.

name: Breathe
lead: When you are stressed or nervous, take five deep breaths
text: Deep breathing reduces stress and lowers blood pressure. It also increases energy, happiness and confidence. Consciously take 5 deep breaths at least 3 times per day.

name: Other Person's Chair
lead: Seek first to understand, then to be understood
text: In order to empathise better with others, put yourself in their shoes. How would you feel and act if you were sitting in their place?

name: Hell Yes / No
lead: If you're not feeling “Hell yes!”, say no
text: We miss out on great because we're busy with mediocre. Say yes to less. Say no to almost everything. This starts to free your time and mind. Then, when you find something you're actually excited about, you'll have the space in your life to give it your full attention. Saying no makes your yes more powerful. Derek Sivers https://sive.rs/hyn

name: Shock the System
lead: Shock your system to get out of old habits and make way for new ones
text: Like jumping into a cold pool. First, it's uncomfortable, but your body adjusts quickly. The initial shock is need to get us going. But it's also what we're most afraid of. Start that project. Quit that job. End that relationship. Take cold showers. Shock your system.

name: Synergize
lead: Synergy comes from the Greek synergos ("working together")
text: Work together to achieve more than you could by yourself. Synergy is better than “my way” or “your way”. It's our way.

name: Keep Learning
lead: Learn something new every day
text: If you learn one new thing every day, you will have learned 365 things after one year. No matter what you do, keep learning.

name: Drink Water
lead: Drink at least 2 liters of water every day
text: Drinking water makes you less hungry, more awake and more alert. It also improves short term memory and mental function. If you want to crush it during the day, stay hydrated.

name: Make Your Bed
lead: Make your bed first thing in the morning
text: If you make your bed in the morning, you will have accomplished the first task of the day. No matter what happens throughout the day, it always feels good to come home to a made bed.

name: Trust Yourself
lead: Start that project
text: …Make that change. Trust yourself. Ten years from now you will be more disappointed by the things you didn't than by the things you did do.

name: Don't-Do List
lead: Keep a Don't-Do List
text: Don't-Dos are things you want to avoid doing at all costs. The list will help you break out of patterns or behaviours you don't want or want to change.

name: Two Minute Rule
lead: If a task takes two minutes or less, do it immediately
text: Gets easy tasks out of your head and out of the way. Adding the task to your mental to-do list and managing the anxiety of not having done it takes more effort than just doing it now.

name: Eat the Frog
lead: Do the most difficult task of the day first
text: Once you completed the most difficult task, everything else will seem easy. If you want to get things done, do them in the morning. As the day progresses, your willpower diminishes. Like a muscle, it becomes tired from overuse.

name: Exercise
lead: Regular exercise improves your health
text: Exercise improves your health, mood, energy, and even your sleep. Find something you enjoy and start doing it at least once a week to kickstart your exercise routine.

name: Eliminate Number Seven
lead: Always eliminate number seven from the options
text: When you ask people to pick a number between 1 and 10, most people will choose seven. To get a more accurate rating, remove number seven as an option.

name: Don't Take No
lead: Don't take "No" from someone who can't give you a "Yes"
text: Every No gets you one step closer to finding a Yes. Persistence pays but be smart who you ask.

name: Tomorrow
lead: There's always tomorrow
text: You can always tell someone to go to hell tomorrow. Sleep on it. You won't have missed the opportunity. Forget about it for a day. If you feel the same way tomorrow, tell them. But don't spout off in a moment of anger.
